Tired of waiting at my desk during 30-min AI agent runs, so I built agy-pilot.

An open-source, self-hosted companion daemon bridging local Google Antigravity to Telegram.

• Away-from-keyboard coding on mobile
• Approve tools & review traces
• 100% local (Python 3.12 + uv, launchd)

⭐️ GitHub: https://github.com/donileong/agy-pilot
📦 PyPI: pip install agy-pilot

Boosts welcome! 🙌
#Python #OpenSource #SelfHosted #AIAgents #DevTools #Antigravity
